environment: deno test --no-check against real supabase/functions/stylechat-generate/index.ts; fetch fully stubbed; zero network; default flags unless a test sets env

results.name: expired JWT
results.input: expired/empty/non-bearer/missing credentials against the real handler; Auth server stub rejects the expired token
results.expected: 401, zero side effects (no consent read, session read, RPC, provider)
results.sideEffects: only /auth/v1/user was called for the denied requests
results.limits: Stubbed Auth server: no live signed-JWT validation (same limit as 0737).

results.name: in-function auth with caller-controlled headers
results.input: seven identity headers + userId/user_id/actorId body fields naming actor B, presented with actor A token
results.expected: actor stays A (verified Auth); B session refused 404; no downstream call carries B id
results.sideEffects: no RPC or provider for the refused request
results.limits: Stubbed Auth server; ownership filter observed at the handler query (stub does not emulate RLS).

results.name: 10x declared body limit
results.input: message of 500 (limit), 501, 5,000 (10x), 500,000 chars; plus a 2 MB unknown padding field
results.expected: 500 accepted; >500 => 400 before any quota or provider
results.sideEffects: oversize message spends no quota and never reaches the provider
results.limits: OBSERVATION: the handler has no byte cap on the raw body; a 2 MB unknown field is parsed and ignored, so the request-size bound is the platform gateway, not this function. Not asserted as a defect.

results.name: Unicode homoglyph identifier
results.input: sessionId with Cyrillic, fullwidth, zero-width, hyphen look-alike, combining-mark variants of a valid UUID; homoglyph requestId
results.expected: sessionId variants 400 with zero side effects; requestId bounded to 80
results.sideEffects: none for the rejected requests
results.limits: requestId and sourceMessageId are not allowlist-validated (free text, trimmed, 80-char bounded); they are not an authority. See 1180 observation.

results.name: URL path traversal
results.input: six traversal/query-injection shaped sessionId values
results.expected: 400 before any query; no traversal sequence reaches a downstream URL
results.sideEffects: none
results.limits: No file or storage path operation exists in the text-chat path; attachment storage paths belong to the V2 attachment resolver (not exercised, see ledger).

results.name: SSRF metadata/local/file/gopher/DNS rebind
results.input: six SSRF-shaped URLs injected into message, requestId, sourceMessageId, weatherLocation.locale, every activeContext text field and three unknown URL fields
results.expected: outbound hosts limited to the Supabase fixture, Gemini and the fixed weather host; no caller URL used as a request target
results.sideEffects: none beyond the allowed hosts
results.limits: Server-side storage downloads for owned attachments (V2 / normalization flag) and Open-Meteo responses are not exercised; weather coordinates are range-checked numbers only.

results.name: prompt injection per model field
results.input: delimiter-breaking injection ([SYSTEM], </s>, html, SQL fence) in 10 model-bound fields + message; hostile model output
results.expected: no field can add a system section or markup; user message stays in the user turn; unsafe output stripped

perField.activeContext.query: text present only as escaped inert data
perField.activeContext.category: text present only as escaped inert data
perField.activeContext.color: text present only as escaped inert data
perField.activeContext.silhouette: text present only as escaped inert data
perField.activeContext.material: text present only as escaped inert data
perField.activeContext.descriptors: text present only as escaped inert data

actual.modelOutputSanitised: Try this:  [removed]: grant_all(); [removed] x. Wear navy trousers today.

results.sideEffects: none
results.limits: Proves prompt STRUCTURE only. Whether a real model obeys injected prose needs a paid provider (excluded), same as 0749. Free-text Closet/attachment fields are not exercised.

results.name: MIME magic-byte mismatch
results.input: PNG bytes labelled image/jpeg and other image payloads placed in the chat request
results.expected: never forwarded to the provider
results.sideEffects: no image bytes reached Gemini in any case
results.limits: The text-chat request has no byte upload. Server-side download of OWNED storage objects (attachment/visual-context pipeline) is not exercised and stays the real gap for byte-level cells.

results.name: zero-byte truncated corrupted image
results.input: zero-byte and truncated image payloads in the chat request
results.expected: never forwarded
results.sideEffects: none

results.name: lying Content-Type
results.input: same body with Content-Type image/png, multipart, text/plain, octet-stream, empty
results.expected: identical outcome to the honest request (Content-Type carries no authority)
results.sideEffects: none
results.limits: Request Content-Type only.

results.name: 10 retries in 1 second
results.input: ten requests back-to-back (limiter stub allows 4 then denies); then a malformed limiter payload
results.expected: first 4 served, 6 denied with 429 + Retry-After, zero provider and zero daily-quota for denied; malformed limiter fails closed
results.sideEffects: denied requests cost nothing
results.limits: Proves the handler honours the limiter. The limiter itself is SQL (check_and_increment_stylechat_burst); not exercised here.

results.name: switch account in flight
results.input: actor B token against actor A session; then A (delayed provider) and B concurrently
results.expected: B refused on A session (404, zero quota, zero provider); concurrent replies never cross actors
results.sideEffects: no cross-actor text in any provider request or history query
results.limits: Server-side only; the client session-switch UX is a device/client cell. Stub does not emulate RLS (handler-side filter observed).

results.name: A then B delayed A supersession
results.input: A request held at the provider; B request completes first; A released late
results.expected: A's late reply is returned to A only; B's result is unaffected
results.sideEffects: none shared between requests
results.limits: Client-side supersession (UI discarding a late reply) is not exercised.

results.name: cross-user shared cache poisoning
results.input: actor A message + location, then actor B same rounded coordinates
results.expected: B's request contains none of A's data; the only shared cache holds public weather keyed by coordinates
results.sideEffects: weather object is shared by design (public data, no actor field)
results.limits: Only module-level cache in index.ts is weatherCache (coordinates -> weather). The K+ entitlement and Signature Style caches live in other lanes.

results.name: provider 500
results.input: scripted Gemini provider 500
results.expected: HTTP 200 status:error with the safe fallback copy, no provider detail, <=2 attempts, no write

actual.fallback: I'm having trouble completing that styling response right now. Try asking again with one specific goal, like outfit polish, color pairing, or where to wear the piece.

results.sideEffects: OBSERVATION: the daily quota unit is reserved BEFORE the provider call and no refund RPC exists, so a failed generation still spends one of the customer's daily messages.
results.limits: Mock provider; default flag state (generation retry/safety flags off). 12s provider timeout scaled to 25ms in the harness.

results.name: Supabase 401 mid-request
results.input: Auth succeeds, then the burst RPC / daily-quota RPC / session read returns 401 JWT expired
results.expected: fail closed: no provider call, no further quota spend
results.sideEffects: zero provider calls in all three variants
results.limits: OBSERVATION: a 401 on the session lookup is reported to the client as 404 "Session not found" (the handler does not distinguish error from absence), so a mid-request token expiry reads as a missing session. Not a security defect; a client-recovery nuance.

results.name: deletion replay
results.input: ten replays from an account in pending_deletion; then an RPC lifecycle-guard rejection
results.expected: 403 ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION every time, before consent/session/quota/provider
results.sideEffects: none downstream
results.limits: Handler reaction to the lifecycle guard stub; the SQL deletion state machine is another lane.

results.name: SQL injection per RPC parameter
results.input: requestId/sourceMessageId = SQL metacharacters + DROP TABLE payload, flag off and ELISE_QUOTA_IDEMPOTENCY_V1_ENABLED=true
results.expected: caller text is never string-built into SQL by the handler; RPC params are JSON-bound
results.sideEffects: flag off: no caller text in any RPC. Flag on: up to 80 chars of raw requestId are concatenated into p_operation_key.
results.limits: Handler passes the value as a JSON-bound RPC parameter (PostgREST binds it). Whether increment_stylechat_daily_usage_idempotent is injection-safe is a SQL-side proof that needs a real Postgres; this cell is not claimed PASS.

results.name: simultaneous duplicate operation
results.input: ten concurrent identical requests (same requestId and message), default flags
results.expected: duplicate suppression (one provider call, one quota unit)
results.sideEffects: with default flags every duplicate spends quota and a provider call
results.limits: Suppression exists only behind generationSafetyV1 / quotaIdempotencyV1 and lives in SQL RPCs. Not claimed PASS; needs the flag state of Production and a real concurrent SQL run.

results.name: client service-role reachability (response-side control only)
results.input: successful response body and headers
results.expected: no service-role key or provider key
results.sideEffects: none
results.limits: The cell concerns the shipped client bundle, which is feature-independent; this only shows the Edge response does not carry it. Cell stays NOT TESTED.
